design_notes: Professional, data-driven aesthetic with a security/intelligence theme. Use a dark text-on-light background scheme (white/very light gray) for optimal readability. Implement a color-coded system for sentiment (green/amber/red) and platform-specific branding. Employ a responsive layout with CSS variables for consistent theming, utilizing subtle shadows, rounded elements, and clear visual hierarchy. Ensure all charts, tables, and data visualizations are accessible and print-friendly in A4 format. Maintain a clean, uncluttered interface suitable for senior law enforcement and intelligence personnel.
